check_method: Same method as P0-M1-T02 (decision record 0001): live query of USPTO Trademark Search (tmsearch.uspto.gov), the WIPO Global Brand Database / TMview aggregate (branddb.wipo.int, 89 data sources incl. terms.search_note: USPTO wordmark search returns NO results for 'isolith' (zero US filings or registrations in any class). WIPO Global Brand Database / TMview embedded search returns 5 records, all in non-software classes (2 = paints/coatings, 5 = pharmaceutical/dental products, 19 = building/insulation materials). No mark in Nice class 9 (software) or class 42 (software design and development services), which are the classes a CAD/CAE/PDM platform uses. Coined combination of ISO (standards, equal) + -lith (stone; printing plate), so phonetic confusion with the unrelated marks below is low and field-specific.

Live US application serial 50149416 filed 2026-10-07 in classes 025, 035 (clothing, business services). Not classes 9/42 but a live US applicant on the identical name narrows clearance; name also reads poorly.
WIPO embedded returns 21 hits including a live German mark in classes 1, 3, 17. Also a known building-insulation product family.
WIPO embedded returns 157 hits. Name space too crowded.
